summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Magsika Studio admin order tracking. 11/11 backend pytest tests pass (auth gating, CRUD with persistence verification, 404 handling, seed idempotency, WebSocket broadcast for create/update/delete). All frontend flows tested via Playwright: login page, protected route redirect to /login, cookie-based auth, dashboard render with klien grid, orders table (12 rows), search filter, klien filter, add order modal, edit, delete, toggle paid, board with 3 artist columns (Budi/Sari/Joko), invoice rendering with correct totals (VtuberCorp = Rp4.400.000), WS Live indicator green. No critical issues found.

issues: Initial WebSocket connect attempts log 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' before connection stabilises; not user-visible and the Live indicator turns green. Consider suppressing onerror log during reconnect or reducing noise.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is defined AFTER @app.on_event('startup') decorator uses it (line 266 references logger before line 279 definition). Works by luck since startup runs after full module load, but is fragile — define logger at top of file.

server.py line 151: session_token is taken directly from Emergent OAuth response (data['session_token']) and used as cookie value + DB key. This is intentional per Emergent playbook but note that logout doesn't invalidate the upstream Emergent session — only local DB record.

Frontend OrdersContext.jsx: reconnectTimer/heartbeatTimer captured in useEffect closure — on unmount the cleanup only clears the most recent timers; early reconnects may leak if called rapidly. Low risk.
server.py /api/auth/session: uses blocking `requests` in async handler — should use httpx/aiohttp to avoid blocking event loop. Low traffic app so acceptable but note for scale.
No rate limiting / no CSRF protection on mutation endpoints — relies solely on httpOnly cookie + Bearer header. Acceptable for internal admin tool but flag.
test_credentials: No real credentials — test user + session_token seeded directly in MongoDB per /app/auth_testing.md. Cleaned up after testing. Google OAuth bypassed. /app/memory/test_credentials.md was empty (expected for OAuth-only app).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test users (test-user-tester, test-user-ui) + matching sessions in mongo during testing. Transient TEST_ orders created via POST /api/orders and deleted via DELETE /api/orders. Final cleanup removed all TEST_ data; 12 seeded sample orders remain intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://order-management-110.preview.emergentagent.com/api is fully functional. To test auth-gated endpoints: seed user+session in mongo test_database (users, user_sessions collections) and pass Authorization: Bearer <session_token> or session_token cookie. WebSocket at wss://<host>/api/ws broadcasts order.created/updated/deleted events to all connected clients (no auth on WS itself). Frontend uses httpOnly SameSite=None Secure cookie — Playwright must add cookie via context.add_cookies with httpOnly=True,secure=True,sameSite='None'. Seed data is idempotent (only inserted if orders count == 0). All APIs exclude MongoDB _id. Test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses pytest with pymongo+websockets+requests.
